info.description: Automated Data-Driven Cyberattack Simulation for Blue Team Training platform REST API.
info.title: SOC Trainer REST API

get.description: Returns structured research and experiment metrics across pre-test, scenario loop, and post-test pursuant to the evaluation protocol.

post.description: Initializes a 30-question Post-Test with zero overlap from the Pre-Test questions.
Initializes a 30-question Pre-Test with required domain distribution (4/7/5/8/6). If an in-progress pre-test already exists, returns the existing session.
post.summary: Start or resume pre-test exam session

get.description: Retrieves a random question from the database question pool for preview.
Recovers the active exam session and questions for the authenticated learner.

post.description: Commits an answer for an exam question and returns progression or final score results.
Authenticates a user and returns a signed JWT token
Creates a new learner account with email, password, and nickname
Records a query action executed by the learner against telemetry logs for auditing and investigation scoring.
post.summary: Execute and record a telemetry log query

get.description: Returns the complete evaluation breakdown, action audit trail, and updated domain proficiencies for a completed simulation session.
get.summary: Get detailed retrospective result of a simulation session

post.description: Records a select_evidence toggle action for an in-progress simulation session and returns the replayed selection.
post.summary: Toggle one telemetry log as selected evidence

post.description: Records one select_evidence clear action for an in-progress simulation session.

get.description: Recovers the in-progress simulation session and scenario data.

post.description: Synthesizes or retrieves the next scenario focused on the learner's weakest domain. If an active simulation exists, resumes it.

get.description: Returns per-domain proficiency status, completed scenario count, and training eligibility.

post.description: Evaluates the learner's TP/FP classification, response actions, and discovered key findings, updating proficiency scores via weighted average.
post.summary: Submit scenario response actions and triage decision

get.description: Returns completed simulation sessions with evidence review counters for specialist triage.

get.description: Returns the full investigation timeline plus the evidence review for one completed simulation session.
